range_contract_on_the_pinned_snapshot.re_freeze_refused_with: RailsError: KnowledgeSnapshot.frozen_json[a2t-kb-toolshaped-9eb5f4bf186a0285]: prior_score must be a probability in [0.0, 1.0] -- 193 of 12601 values are outside it (value:tier1_direct:001010=1.956043956043956, value:tier1_direct:001013=1.956043956043956, value:tier1_direct:001063=1.5274725274725274, value:tier1_direct:001066=1.5274725274725274, value:tier1_direct:001580=2.493827160493827, +188 more). A ratio whose numerator is not restricted to its denominator's conditioning event is not a conditional probability; restrict the numerator rather than rescaling the result.

slurp_nesting_identity.argument: intent is built as f'{scenario}_{action}', so an intent determines its scenario and the restricted numerator's row SET is the same SET as the unrestricted one. The repair is therefore an exact identity on SLURP -- which is why SLURP never exposed the defect, and equally why the SLURP code was never correct BY CONSTRUCTION.
slurp_nesting_identity.finding_if_it_had_failed: a single intent appearing under two scenarios would mean the SLURP prior was wrong in flight exactly as the A2T one was; the counts above are the check, not a restatement of the argument

source_verification.defect_a2t: rails/knowledge_build_a2t.py:1085-1087 set prior_score = tool_total / category_total, where tool_total = len(rows_by_tool_full[tool]) is accumulated at line 853 over the WHOLE construction pool and category_total = len(rows_by_category_full[(domain, category)]) is accumulated at line 854 over one (domain, category). The numerator's row set is NOT a subset of the denominator's, so the ratio is not p(tool | domain, category) and has no reason to be <= 1.
source_verification.defect_slurp: rails/knowledge_build.py:696-698 set prior_score = intent_total_in_scenario / scenario_total, where intent_total_in_scenario = len(rows_by_intent_full[intent]) is accumulated at line 504 over the WHOLE row set, NOT over the scenario. It is the identical expression shape. The local's NAME asserted a restriction the code did not perform. SLURP is safe only because intent = f'{scenario}_{action}' (line 202) makes an intent determine its scenario -- an accident of the label vocabulary, not a property of the expression.

live_tree_after_repair.finding_as_landed_at_3f131afd: BOTH builders compute prior_score as count(key_N over ALL rows) / count(key_D over ALL rows) with key_N != key_D and no restriction of the numerator to the denominator's key. SLURP's ratio is a conditional probability only because intent = f'{scenario}_{action}' nests intent inside scenario in the LABEL VOCABULARY; the local name 'intent_total_in_scenario' asserts a restriction the expression does not perform. The SLURP builder therefore carries the identical latent defect and would break exactly as the A2T builder did under a non-nesting label scheme.
live_tree_after_repair.finding_now: REPAIRED. Both builders now restrict the numerator to the conditioning event -- SLURP count(intent AND scenario) / count(scenario), Audio2Tool count(tool AND (domain, category)) / count((domain, category)) -- and both call knowledge.assert_prior_scores_are_probabilities on the values they assemble, so a non-probability prior_score can no longer be built. The SLURP repair is an EXACT IDENTITY because intent determines scenario; the Audio2Tool repair is not, and its before/after distribution is published in docs/readiness/2026-08-25-prior-score-semantics-repair.md. The landed synthesis document and its receipt are NOT rewritten: the pre-repair lines stay published above as the historical record.
